incident_date_approx: May 2024 (two occasions), White County Jail, Monticello, Indiana
description: A former White County Jail inmate filed a civil lawsuit on May 1, 2026 in Marion Superior Court against White County Sheriff Bill Brooks, former correctional officer William Cottrell, and the White County Board of Commissioners. The suit alleges that Cottrell sexually assaulted her on two occasions in May 2024 while she was incarcerated at the jail. Cottrell pleaded guilty in March 2026 to one count of sexual misconduct arising from the incidents and was sentenced to three years with two years suspended. The complaint brings claims of negligence, sexual battery (against Cottrell), and civil rights violations, alleging the county defendants were aware of correctional officers' sexual misconduct but did nothing to prevent it and failed to reasonably care for the welfare of inmates. According to the complaint, the plaintiff served the defendants a tort claim notice in August 2024 that went unanswered before she filed suit. The case is in its early stages.
